backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining the backend for a comment/image/chat management app, including CRUD operations for comment lists, templates, app events, chat messages, images, settings, and comment assignment/generation logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report confirming that a Top-Down Shooter game card was added to UserView.tsx above the Single Comment Generator section, with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose and key changes, serving as a reference for the current state of the frontend codebase.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including colors for background, card, primary, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, mounting the root div and loading the main TypeScript module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app shell with a sticky header (logo, countdown timer, music toggle), floating background shape decorations, four-tab navigation (User View, Upload, Live Checker, Admin), and background music management.
frontend/src/components/AdminUnlock.tsx: Admin unlock component rendering a password input form that gates admin access using a 4-digit code via the useAdminAuth hook.
frontend/src/components/BulkCommentGener: Bulk Comment Generator component that lets users select a comment list, quantity, and access key to generate multiple comments at once, with available-count tracking and copy-to-clipboard support.
frontend/src/components/MetricsDonutChar: Renders an SVG donut chart showing the percentage of used templates out of total templates, with a gradient arc and centered percentage text.
frontend/src/components/TopDownShooter.t: A canvas-based top-down shooter mini-game where the player moves with keyboard input, shoots at enemies by clicking, and tracks score and time.
frontend/src/components/UploadComment.ts: A form component that lets users type and submit a comment via the addChatMessage mutation, displaying loading, success, and error states.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches an ICP backend actor (authenticated or anonymous) based on the current Internet Identity, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminAuth.ts: Manages admin authentication state using a hardcoded PIN code, persisting the unlocked status in sessionStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useBackgroundMusic.ts: Controls looping background audio playback based on a provided URL and enabled flag, exposing play and pause controls.
frontend/src/hooks/useCommentGenerator.t: Provides utility functions to generate single or bulk random comments by picking templates from a CommentList and optionally appending a suffix or symbol.
frontend/src/hooks/useCountdown.ts: Returns a live countdown (hours, minutes, seconds) to the next midnight, updating every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useDeviceId.ts: Generates and persists a unique device ID in localStorage, returning it as a stable string.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider and useInternetIdentity hook for managing ICP Internet Identity authentication, including login, logout, and identity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend interactions including CRUD operations on comment lists, available counts, images, apps/events, and comment assignment/export functionality.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind, imports fonts, defines CSS custom properties for a dark neon/glass theme, and provides utility classes like neon-text, glass-card, gradient-btn, and space-card.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/utils/templateGenerator.ts: Utility that generates randomized app review comment templates by combining tone (positive/neutral/critical), category (performance/ui/features/support), and length parameters.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminAITemplate: Admin panel tab for generating comment templates locally based on topic, tone, count, and optional suffix, then selectively adding chosen templates to an existing comment list.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminChat.tsx: Admin chat component that displays a scrollable list of timestamped messages fetched every 5 seconds and allows admins to send new messages.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminComments.t: Admin panel for managing comment lists: create, rename, delete, lock/unlock lists, add templates via textarea, and view per-list metrics with a donut chart.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminImages.tsx: Admin image management panel that supports uploading images with a name and comma-separated tags, shows an upload progress bar, and displays the existing image gallery.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminLiveList.t: Admin panel for managing app/event username lists: create events, add or bulk-upload usernames, inline-rename or delete events, and check whether a username exists across selected events.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminSettings.t: Admin settings page component that allows toggling background music, uploading a music file, and managing (viewing, setting, or regenerating) the app access key.
frontend/src/views/admin/AdminView.tsx: Admin panel container that renders a tab navigation (Comments, AI Templates, Images, Chat, Live List, Settings) and displays the corresponding admin sub-view, gated behind admin authentication.
frontend/src/views/LiveChecker.tsx: View component that lets users check whether usernames exist within app/event lists, displaying found/not-found results per username with expandable app breakdowns.
frontend/src/views/UploadView.tsx: View component providing three upload workflows: single comment upload, bulk comment generation, file-based template upload to a selected list, and image upload to the backend.
frontend/src/views/UserView.tsx: Main user-facing view that displays unlocked comment lists, allows users to generate and copy a comment per list (persisted in localStorage by device ID), and includes an embedded top-down shooter game.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom fonts, OKLCH-based color tokens, border radii, neon box shadows, and keyframe animations for a dark space-themed UI.
project_state.json: Project state metadata describing the Comment Management app's architecture, existing features, known issues, and a pending feature request to add a Top-Down Shooter game card in the User View.
